name: Manufacturing & Industrial
description: Discrete and process manufacturing, industrial utility systems, packaging, and quality control equipment.

sub_industries.name: Process Manufacturing
sub_industries.description: Continuous process manufacturing including reactors, heat exchangers, and distillation equipment.

device_types.name: Reactor / Process Vessel
device_types.description: Pressure vessel used for chemical or biological reactions. Primary monitoring focus is process safety and product quality control.

tags.name: Process Temperature
tags.description: Reactor temperature. Primary process control variable affecting reaction rate and product quality.

tags.name: Process Pressure
tags.description: Reactor pressure. Critical safety parameter; high pressure triggers relief devices.

tags.name: Fill Level
tags.description: Vessel fill level as a percentage of total volume.

tags.name: Agitator Speed
tags.description: Mixing agitator speed in RPM. Affects mixing efficiency and heat transfer.

tags.name: pH
tags.description: Process pH. Controls reaction chemistry and product specification.

device_types.name: Heat Exchanger
device_types.description: Shell-and-tube or plate heat exchanger transferring thermal energy between two process streams.

tags.name: Hot Side Inlet Temp
tags.description: Temperature of the hot process fluid entering the exchanger.

tags.name: Hot Side Outlet Temp
tags.description: Temperature of the hot process fluid leaving the exchanger.

tags.name: Cold Side Inlet Temp
tags.description: Temperature of the cold process fluid entering the exchanger.

tags.name: Cold Side Outlet Temp
tags.description: Temperature of the cold process fluid leaving the exchanger.

tags.name: Flow Rate
tags.description: Process fluid flow rate through the exchanger.

sub_industries.name: Compressed Air / Industrial Utilities
sub_industries.description: Industrial utility systems supplying compressed air, nitrogen, or other process gases to manufacturing equipment.

device_types.name: Air Compressor
device_types.description: Industrial rotary screw or reciprocating air compressor supplying compressed air to pneumatic tools and process equipment.

tags.name: Discharge Pressure
tags.description: Compressed air discharge pressure. Drops when demand exceeds supply capacity.

tags.name: Discharge Temperature
tags.description: Compressed air temperature at discharge. High temps indicate cooling issues.

tags.name: Power Consumption
tags.description: Compressor motor power. Used for specific power (kW/scfm) efficiency tracking.

tags.name: Flow Rate
tags.description: Compressed air delivery rate in standard cubic feet per minute.

tags.name: Run Hours
tags.description: Cumulative operating hours for maintenance scheduling.
